resources.string: Add your options and press Spin. You can register between 2 and 24 items. Paste text with one entry per line to add them all at once.
When the result is already decided
Press and hold an item for about 0.6 seconds and it will be the one the next spin lands on. Hold again to clear it.

The mark only appears while you are touching an item and right after you set it. It disappears while spinning and while the result is up, and stays hidden while the screen is being shared or recorded. This section closes itself the moment you press Spin.
With nothing marked, the result really is random.
Picking who organizes the party, choosing where to have lunch, setting the running order, assigning chores, forfeits, or standing in for a coin toss. No sign-up, free to use.
